_note: This file is a configuration-only Python module (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines dictionary-based config objects for MMSegmentation framework.
summarize_model_config: summarize the UPerNet MAE model config with backbone, neck, decode_head, and auxiliary_head settings
review_norm_cfg: review the SyncBN normalization config used across decode and auxiliary heads
